description: START HERE when a user asks how to promote their app, software, service, game or course, or wants UGC videos. Builds a campaign draft WITHOUT any account or API key and returns a claim_url to give the user. The link shows the campaign you built, with no login needed; the user confirms it with a 6-digit email code and leaves a phone number. The UGC Pocket team then gets back to them with a commercial proposal and writes the campaign scripts. Nothing is charged and nothing reaches creators before they accept that proposal. The draft expires in 7 days. Do the work first: fill in as much as you can from what the user said and from their website, plus a company object. If the user gives their email, pass it: they also receive the link by email. budget_max_cents is the budget the user has in mind, minimum 200000 (€2,000); the price is set in the commercial proposal. Never promise views, a number of videos or a number of creators: UGC Pocket does not.

brief.description: What the product is, who it is for, and what the videos should show.

budget_max_cents.description: The budget the user has in mind for the campaign, in euro cents. Minimum 200000 (€2,000). Indicative only: the price is set in the commercial proposal.

company.description: The company the campaign is for, as you understood it. Shown on the claim page.

description.description: One line on what the company does.

deadline.description: YYYY-MM-DD, in the future. Any other value is ignored.

email.description: The user's email, if they gave it. They receive the claim link by email too.

language.description: The user's language, for that email. Defaults to the language of the brief.

target_categories.description: Creator categories whose audience fits the product.

title.description: Campaign title, e.g. the product and the angle.

name: create_campaign_draft

claim_url.description: Public URL to give to the user. No login needed to view it.

emailed.description: true when the claim link was also sent to the email you passed.

next_step.description: What to tell the user now.
